label: Figure 6
title: How ginger makes 6-gingerol: what is shown and what is proposed
caption: The route from phenylalanine to 6-gingerol and on to 6-shogaol, as the labelling, enzyme and genome studies describe it. Solid steps have been shown with ginger material or ginger enzymes; the dashed step is inferred and its enzymes are not yet known; the last step is chemistry, not biology.
how_to_read: Follow the arrows left to right. A solid arrow is a step shown experimentally, a dashed arrow is proposed, and the final arrow is the conversion that happens when ginger is dried or cooked. Open a box for its evidence.
